title: The Excluded Vertex-Minors and Pivot-Minors for Rank-Width at Most Two
summary: We determine both the excluded vertex-minors and the excluded pivot-minors for the class of graphs of rank-width at most two. Up to local equivalence and graph isomorphism, there are exactly 25 excluded vertex-minors: 1 graph on 8 vertices, 18 on 9 vertices, and 6 on 10 vertices. Up to pivot equivalence and graph isomorphism, there are exactly 609 excluded pivot-minors: 2 on 8 vertices, 447 on 9 vertices, 146 on 10 vertices, 10 on 11 vertices, and 4 on 12 vertices.
